summary: H World Group Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting second quarter 2026 unaudited financial results, including revenue of RMB7.1 billion (up 10.8% YoY) and net income of RMB1.6 billion. The board approved a three-year shareholder return plan of US$2.5 billion and declared an ordinary cash dividend, but no specific dividend amount is provided in the excerpt. This is a routine earnings release with a capital return program announcement, not a special-situation event. The 6-K incorporates exhibits into its F-3 registration statement. No M&A, tender, or restructuring activity is present. Watch for future details on the dividend and buyback execution.
